_comment: PLACEHOLDER values. Copy to config.json and replace every pixel pick with a reading off your own sheet images (README, 'Landmarks'). Pixel y runs down; x runs right; all picks are in the pixels of the prepared sheet (work/prep/<name>.png). Nothing here describes a real person.
_notes: bust.skin_only: head pictures texture skin only (their clothes are ignored). bust.neck_reach_below_chin_m: how far below the chin head pictures may texture skin (they do so only where the body pictures also show skin). rigid_hands: fingers follow the hand bone. neck_drop_m: the head sits this much lower on the body than the body sheet's chin landmark says (generated bodies often have a long neck). neck_thicken: radial scale on the lofted neck rings between the cut and the jaw line (1 = the bust's own neck). Optional keys read with defaults: sheets, views, cloth_wins, collar_rules, soft_collar, soft_collar_steps, head_own_below_chin_m, head_fallback_body, projectors, slim_base_m.
